text:
incident-bot: 🚨 Page triggered — hosted-api /v1/generate 5xx rate spiked to 6.2% (5m avg). p95 latency 2.1s. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/hosted-api/errors

alex: I'm on it. Marking sev-2 for now. seeing error burst from us-west-2 clusters. will triage pods + routing.

maria: thanks. can you confirm if fallback model variants kicked in? that might mask root cause but reduce QPS to the stable pool.

alex: checked — fallback to redwood-mini-v1 did trigger for ~15% of requests. routing logs: `route_fallback=enabled` for a subset. Weirdly, a few model-serving pods are OOMKilled in the last 12m. grabbing kube logs.

devon: FYI autoscaler tried to scale but hit cloud quota for GPU instances — saw 403 from cloud API. I'm pulling cloud console.

alex: quick mitigation — increased fallback weight to 0.6 and disabled expensive prewarm for this pool. commands run:
```
# bump fallback
redwoodctl routing set-weight --route /v1/generate --variant redwood-mini-v1 0.6
# remove prewarm to free memory
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/model-pool PREWARM=false
```
output: `ok` and pods restarted; error rate dropped to 1.1% in 6m. latency p95 back to 1.0s.

maria: good short-term. can we open a ticket for quota/scale limits + investigate OOM root cause? would like a postmortem if this was caused by model change or data spike.

alex: filing now — RN-2026. brief: "Autoscaler failed to provision due to cloud GPU quota; several model-serving pods OOMKilled; fallback and routing adjusted for mitigation." link: https://redwood.app/tickets/RN-2026

ops-bot: Ticket RN-2026 created by alex and assigned to @devon, priority: P1.

devon: assigned. early rollback check: no model deploys in the last 24h to that pool, so more likely resource pressure or memory regression in model binary. will capture heap/metrics.

alex: handing off to morning shift — maria will take primary at 08:00 UTC, devon takes secondary. Handing over current state:
- current mitigation: fallback weight 0.6, prewarm disabled, additional restarts done
- customer impact: transient increased errors for 18m, most traffic routed to fallback; a few requests retried near-term. Customers on Dedicated unaffected.
- open ticket: RN-2026 (quota + OOMs)
- dashboards: https://redwood.app/d/hosted-api/errors and https://redwood.app/d/infra/instances

maria: ack — I'll own post-handoff. plan: validate memory profiles, check recent container images + model binary size, and confirm autoscaler will succeed if we request capacity. devon will look at quota request process with cloud infra.

incident-bot: on-call handoff recorded: previous primary alex -> new primary maria at 08:00 UTC. oncall rotation: https://redwood.app/oncall

alex: one more note — there is a coverage gap tomorrow morning 07:30–08:00 UTC. I need to leave early for client meeting. maria, devon: can you confirm someone will be reachable in that window? if not, I'll extend my shift by 30m, but prefer not to.

maria: I can cover 07:30–09:00. devon will be available on pager for quota escalation.

alex: added explicit runbook pointer in the ticket: steps to revert routing + how to force scale via cloud CLI. snippet from runbook:
```
1) Check fallback: redwoodctl routing get /v1/generate
2) If errors persist, set backup-variant weight 0.75
3) To force scale: cloudctl compute instances create --type gpu-n1 --count 2 --project infra-pprod
4) Collect pod logs: kubectl -n inference logs deploy/model-pool --since=30m > /tmp/modelpool.log
```

devon: note in RN-2026: add quota request doc link and contact for cloud-svc-team. I'll kick off quota increase request this morning.

maria: post-handoff follow-ups I'll take after 08:00:
- validate OOM stack traces and correlate with model versions (owner: maria)
- check if KV cache growth caused memory pressure (owner: devon)
- verify autoscaler behavior under synthetic load (owner: devon)
- update runbook with clearer prewarm flags and fallback thresholds (owner: alex)

alex: scheduled a short retro tomorrow 15:00 UTC. calendar invite: https://redwood.app/cal/event/retro-RN-2026. running doc: https://redwood.app/notebook/RN-2026/analysis

maria: thanks — I'll file smaller follow-up tickets from RN-2026 for the runbook edits and test plan.

sre-rotation: marking this thread as handoff-complete. If anything spikes again tag @maria and escalate.

maria: ack and thanks everyone. keeping watch for the next 45m then will fully own. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks team — leaving notes in RN-2026 for tracelog paths. back on-call if needed. :wave:
